           RHUS AROMATICA

         Fragrant Sumach


Renal and urinary affections, especially   diabetes  .
        Enuresis due to vesical atony; senile incontinence. Hæmaturia and cystitis come within the
        range of this remedy.



Urine.--    Pale  , albuminous.   Incontinence. Severe pain at beginning or before urination  ,
        causing great agony in children. Constant dribbling.   Diabetes  ,
        large quantities of urine of low specific gravity (  Phos ac; Acet ac  ).



Dose.--  Tincture, in rather material doses.
